column1: # VS Code extensions that shipped malware, as Open VSX and the VS Code marketplace published them.
# One line each, tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
#   id        publisher.name, as the extension's folder spells it (compared without case)
#   version   the exact version, or * when every version is malware
#   incident  an id from data/incidents.tsv, whose level must be act
# Looked for as <id>-<version> folders (a platform suffix such as -darwin-arm64 may follow) in the
# extension folders of VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium and Kiro. GlassWorm: Socket, January 2026.
